terms.grammar: genitive of nātūra, after its noun
evidence: M-O s.v. ecology: rērum nātūra, the natural world (Egger)
terms.comment: Latin says “of nature”: environmental protection is nātūrae tūtēla, environmental damage nātūrae dētrīmentum; harmful to the environment, quod nātūrae nocet. The environment as the natural world is nātūra or rērum nātūra (see nature); as one’s surroundings, circumjecta (see environment).
Egger’s word, from Greek οἶκος; also in rēs oecologica, environmental affairs (M-O s.v. minister). A plain description is clearer where one will do.

phrases.english: This is bad for the environment.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.vv. ecology, ecological, environmental; minister of environmental affairs.
